text:
amanda: Alert - unusual KMS Decrypt spike for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 across multiple resources. 4 decrypts in 2m from service-account-prod. opening command room.
oncall-bot: [alert] KMS Decrypt anomaly detected (rule: kms-decrypt-rate). link: https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/4512 :rotating_light:
josh: on it. can someone paste the CloudTrail event IDs and the targets? need to know what was decrypted (model artifacts or secrets).
liam: pulling CloudTrail now. running: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-15T14:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-15T14:10:00Z```
sarah: adding secops. tagging incident: KMS-UNEXPECTED-DECRYPT. @charles @natalie please standby for containment guidance.
charles: quick triage: 1) are calls coming from a single IP or many? 2) is this cross-account? 3) which principals invoked Decrypt?
amanda: event metadata: principal = svc-prod-runner@redwood[service-account-prod], sourceIp = 34.201.45.12, resource = s3://models-prod/bert-2026.tar.enc, requestContext shows assume-role session.
josh: that IP maps to a known infra host in prod ASG. could be a compromised instance or stolen credentials. lock down ASG instance until we confirm.
liam: S3 access logs show GET requests for that object at same timestamps. object size matches new model artifact pushed 2h earlier. verifying who uploaded.
charles: containment plan (proposed): 1) Rotate KMS key grant that allows Decrypt for service-account-prod (remove grant or add deny policy). 2) Revoke service-account-prod credentials (short-lived sessions + revoke STS tokens via cache). 3) Isolate instance 34.201.45.12 (move to quarantine SG / stop). 4) Snapshot instance for forensics. Anyone object to immediate revoke? :warning:
sarah: +1 to revoke now. we need to avoid further decrypts. Note: rotating CMK will not prevent already-exchanged temporary creds from working if grant still exists; prefer explicit deny on key policy for that principal.
amanda: applying deny policy patch to CMK now. patch command: ```aws kms put-key-policy --key-id abcd-ef01 --policy file://deny-service-account-prod.json``` file contains explicit Deny for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/service-account-prod for Decrypt action.
oncall-bot: policy update succeeded (request-id: f2a3b4c).
josh: revoking STS sessions for that role: ```aws sts revoke-session --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/service-account-prod --session-id all``` (run via our internal helper). running now.
liam: instance 34.201.45.12 put into quarantine SG and snapshot taken: snap-0a1b2c. logs and disk image preserved.
atalie: I'm picking up the handoff for day shift at 2026-03-15T22:00Z. summary for next oncall: suspect: potential compromised prod runner. containment actions taken: deny applied to CMK, role sessions revoked, instance quarantined and snap created, S3 object access under review. next steps: rotate model artifact key, rotate any publish pipeline creds, full ACL + IAM review for role. I will run a full credential audit and post results to this thread.
charles: add action: run ECR and CI pipeline token rotation for last 24h deploys. also run odd-login detection across account.
amanda: evidence saved in case/INC-2026-0315, assigned to secops for deep forensics. attaching preliminary timeline: 14:02 alert, 14:03 deny policy applied, 14:05 sessions revoked, 14:07 instance quarantined, 14:20 snapshot complete.
secops-bot: Created ticket SEC-7891 (forensics) assigned to @sarah and @charles. Priority: high.
sarah: thanks. Natalie — when you take over, please confirm: a) list of all decrypts in last 24h b) which S3 objects touched c) CI pipeline tokens rotated d) final incident severity assessment.
natalie: will post full 24h decrypt list by 2026-03-15T23:30Z and confirm rotations. tagging: @oncall to escalate if any further decrypts appear.
amanda: closing active command-room handoff at 14:40 UTC. leaving the thread for day handoff. good job team, please keep notes concise in SEC ticket. :white_check_mark:
